/* Skill cards ({{Skill|ID}}) and skill trees ({{Skilltree|...}}): clicking a version name (Basic, Flame ...), a chain icon
   or the rank item button (Fantasia of Sorcery) shows that card.
   Without this script the same switching is done by CSS (:target), but then only one card per page can be switched
   independently, the address of the page changes, and in a skill tree the open card closes when the pointer leaves it.
   With it, every card on the page keeps its own choice, the address does not change, the page does not scroll, the icon
   of a skill tree tile follows the card that is shown, and a skill tree card that was clicked open stays open.
   Paste at the end of MediaWiki:Common.js */
mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( function ( $content ) {
	$content.find( '.aa-skill-set' ).each( function () {
		var set = this;
		if ( set.getAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js' ) ) { return; }
		set.setAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js', '1' );
		var tile = set.closest ? set.closest( '.aa-tree-tile' ) : null;

		function isSwitch( e ) {
			var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( 'a[href*="#aa-skill"]' ) : null;
			return link && /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.test( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) ) ? link : null;
		}

		// a click on a link would move the focus from the tile to the link, and the open card would close
		set.addEventListener( 'mousedown', function ( e ) {
			if ( tile && isSwitch( e ) ) { e.preventDefault(); }
		} );

		set.addEventListener( 'click', function ( e ) {
			var link = isSwitch( e );
			if ( !link ) { return; }
			var m = /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.exec( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) );
			var box = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-varset-v' + m[1] );
			if ( !box ) { return; }
			e.preventDefault();
			Array.prototype.forEach.call( set.querySelectorAll( ':scope > .aa-varset' ), function ( o ) {
				o.style.display = ( o === box ) ? 'grid' : 'none';
			} );
			Array.prototype.forEach.call( box.children, function ( card ) {
				card.style.visibility = card.classList.contains( 'aa-card-k' + m[2] ) ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
			} );
			// the icon of a skill tree tile
			var icons = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-tileicons' );
			if ( icons ) {
				Array.prototype.forEach.call( icons.children, function ( ic ) {
					ic.style.display = ( ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-v' + m[1] ) && ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-k' + m[2] ) ) ? 'block' : 'none';
				} );
			}
			if ( tile ) { tile.focus( { preventScroll: true } ); }
		} );
	} );
} );
